## The problem

What are you trying to do that the tool does not handle today?

## The idea

How you imagine it working. Flags, output, behaviour — whatever you have.

## Alternatives you considered

Workarounds you tried, or reasons the existing options fall short.

## Anything from your own runs

Real examples make the case faster, but this tool reads your Long-Term Memory, so check
anything you paste for private content first.
